name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI pair programmer with inline code suggestions, chat, and agent mode
verdictSummary: You can install an open-source alternative like Continue.dev and get similar completion UX. But Copilot's moat is GitHub's training data, the specialized fill-in-the-middle models, IDE-level integration across VS Code/JetBrains/Neovim, and the code review and PR summarization features. The model quality and deep editor integration are not one-shot replicable.
coreLoopDIY: VS Code extension with inline completions calling a code LLM API
moatNotes: The models are trained on GitHub's unique corpus of code with permissive licenses — that data advantage is nearly impossible to replicate
whyPeopleStillPay: Deep integration with the GitHub ecosystem and models trained on the world's largest code corpus

priorArt.name: Continue.dev
priorArt.desc: Open-source AI code assistant supporting multiple LLM providers

notes: Continue.dev is the open-source alternative. For a one-shot, build a simpler completion extension.
